dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid symmetrical 2D narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with high median pixel intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density grey pixel clustering primarily localized along the longitudinal central axis and the posterior terminus.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary white skin and the darker pigmented central stripe.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One thin, light-grey, curved linear mark located in the anterior-mid dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible curved linear scar in the anterior-mid dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, dark-grey longitudinal stripe extending along the central dorsal ridge.
